name: simulate-annuity-purchase-funding-boundary
why: Measured reach for the annual purchased-annuity funding boundary extracted from simulatePlan. Four dedicated block-V members run in all four equivalence modes and discriminate ordered taxable gain/loss folding, shared-source shadow debits and basis, fractional equity-comp basis arithmetic, partial and zero funding, QLAC cap-before-shortfall warnings, qualified runtime debit/credit ordering, optimizer debits, ledger publication, investment-in-contract carry, and cross-year selection. Entries exclude only validated-input-impossible guard bodies and late-start warning bodies that parsePlan refuses before a corpus member can run; focused helper and delegation tests pin those supported direct-call contracts.

QLAC owner birth-month selection through the shared civil-date parser
positional overlay setup, account selection and first funding-position lookup
entries.note: The missing-funding body on lines 93-95 is excluded: parsePlan requires every annuity purchase fundingAccountId to resolve to a supported funding account. The helper unit suite covers the structural missing-id input and first-position behavior directly; validated Plan input also rejects a duplicate id once an annuity purchase references it.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. The reach command additionally fails on every cold executable whole line in a reached range. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every optional-chain, nullish, ternary, or compound-condition operand sharing a physical line, so reported cold sub-line regions and the focused helper/delegation tests must be read alongside this differential proof.
